literal: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, spring, first month, on bingyin day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, on bingyin day of the first spring month, the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the second month, on gengzi day, Song sent envoys presenting relics of their late emperor.
idiomatic: On gengzi day in the second month Song sent envoys bearing relics of their deceased emperor.

literal: On jiayin day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In the third month, on guihai day, Yelü Sha and Delie presented Song captives taken in the campaign to aid Han.
idiomatic: On guihai day in the third month Yelü Sha and Delie presented Song prisoners captured during the expedition to aid Han.

literal: On wuchen day, an edict granted Han two hundred thousand hu of grain as aid.
idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered two hundred thousand hu of grain sent to aid Han.

literal: In summer, fifth month, on gengwu day, Han sent envoys to give thanks and also to report Song affairs.
idiomatic: On gengwu day in the fifth summer month Han sent envoys to offer thanks and to report developments with Song.

literal: On jichou day, twenty-one Jurchen came requesting chancellor and yilijin posts; they were granted in order of precedence.
idiomatic: On jichou day twenty-one Jurchen petitioned for chancellor and yilijin offices and were appointed in turn according to rank.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen day, Prince of Song Xiyin was made Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: On bingchen day in the sixth month Prince of Song Xiyin was appointed Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengshen day the new moon, Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the seventh autumn month the Uighurs sent tribute envoys.

literal: On jiazi day, Song sent envoys on a visit.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Song dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.

literal: On renshen day, Han reported that Song had invaded.
idiomatic: On renshen day Han sent word that Song had launched an incursion.

literal: On bingzi day, envoys were dispatched with war horses to aid Han.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court sent envoys with war horses to reinforce Han.

literal: In the eighth month, Han sent envoys presenting grape wine.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Han sent envoys presenting grape wine as tribute.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, Yelü Sha brought Tangut surrendering chiefs Kechou and Maiyou to audience; an edict was granted to comfort and instruct them.
idiomatic: On jiazi day in the tenth winter month Yelü Sha presented the surrendering Tangut chiefs Kechou and Maiyou at court and received an edict of reassurance and instruction for them.

literal: On dingmao day, Kechou was made Minister of Education and Maiyou Grand Guardian; each was given gifts and sent away.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Kechou was appointed Minister of Education and Maiyou Grand Guardian; each received gifts and was dismissed.

literal: On renshen day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On renshen day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.

literal: On yiyou day, Han again sent envoys reporting Song affairs.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Han again dispatched envoys to report on Song.

literal: In the eleventh month, on dinghai day the new moon, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the sun ought to be eclipsed but was not obscured.
idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy reported that a solar eclipse was due but the sun showed no obscuration.

literal: On wuxu day, more than four hundred households of Tuyuhun who had rebelled and entered Taiyuan were sought out and returned.
idiomatic: On wuxu day more than four hundred Tuyuhun households that had rebelled and fled into Taiyuan were tracked down and sent back.

literal: On guimao day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On yisi day, Grand Guardian Dielege and others were dispatched as envoys to Song.
idiomatic: On yisi day Grand Guardian Dielege and others were sent as envoys to Song.

literal: On yimao day, Han again sent envoys reporting Song affairs.
idiomatic: On yimao day Han once more sent envoys reporting developments with Song.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen day, he hunted in the near suburbs and sacrificed the catch to heaven.
idiomatic: On wuchen day in the twelfth month the Emperor hunted near the capital and offered the game in sacrifice to heaven.

literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, he went to Chang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, on guichou day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.

literal: In the second month, on gengwu day, Asalan Uighur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengwu day in the second month the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.

literal: In the third month, on gengyin day, sacrifice was performed at Xian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On gengyin day in the third month the court sacrificed at Xian Mausoleum.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, he traveled west.
idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth summer month the Emperor traveled west.

literal: On jisi day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the fifth month, on guimao day, Nüli was granted death; men were dispatched to execute Gao Xun and others.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the fifth month Nüli was put to death and agents were sent to execute Gao Xun and his associates.

literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the court halted at Willow Lake.
idiomatic: On jiwei day in the sixth month the court made camp at Willow Lake.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, sacrifice was offered at Taizu Temple.
idiomatic: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the court offered sacrifice at Taizu Temple.

literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei day the new moon, Prince of Ping Longxian's son Chenge plotted to kill his father; he was dismembered by cart and displayed.
idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the ninth month Chenge, son of Prince of Ping Longxian, plotted to murder his father and was torn apart by carts as a public warning.

literal: That winter, the court encamped at Jinchuan.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.

literal: In the first year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on yiyou day, tamasa Changshou was dispatched as envoy to Song to ask the reason for raising troops against Liu Jiyuan.
idiomatic: In the first year of Qianheng, on yiyou day of the first spring month, tamasa Changshou was sent to Song to demand an explanation for mobilizing against Liu Jiyuan.

literal: On bingshen day, Changshou returned and said, "The mandate of Hedong must be called to account.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Changshou returned and reported, "The Hedong regime must answer for its offenses.

literal: "If the Northern Court does not aid us, the peace treaty remains as before; otherwise there will be war.
idiomatic: "If the Northern Court refuses aid, the old treaty still stands; if not, we fight."

literal: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han, with Song troops pressing the border, sent envoys begging aid.
idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han sent envoys begging relief, reporting that Song armies were pressing the frontier.

literal: An edict appointed Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha as commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie as army supervisor to go to their aid;
idiomatic: An edict named Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie army supervisor and ordered them to march to Han's relief;

literal: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also ordered to follow with his command, and Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi to supervise them.
idiomatic: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also commanded to follow with his troops, under the supervision of Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi.

literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Susa sent men reporting that chieftains of a separate division, Huage and others, had surrendered; they were accepted.
idiomatic: On xinsi day in the third month Susa reported that Huage and other chiefs of a detached division had submitted, and they were received.

literal: On bingxu day, Han sent envoys thanking the court for comforting army and people; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan with troops.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Han sent envoys thanking the court for reassuring troops and civilians; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan.

literal: On jichou day, Han again reported Song troops entering the border; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit troops south in relief.
idiomatic: On jichou day Han again reported a Song incursion; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit forces south to reinforce.

literal: On xinmao day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.

literal: On dingyou day, Yelü Sha and others fought Song at White Horse Ridge with an unfavorable outcome; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo all died, and soldiers were killed and wounded in great numbers.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Yelü Sha and the others battled Song at White Horse Ridge and were defeated; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo were killed, and casualties among the troops were very heavy.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, Han memorialized on campaign affairs; Lu Jun raced from Daizhou with an urgent report.
idiomatic: On xinhai day in the fourth summer month Han submitted reports on the campaign, and Lu Jun galloped from Daizhou with an emergency dispatch.

literal: On xinyou day, Delie came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Delie arrived with tribute.

literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day the new moon, Song troops reached Hedong; Han fought them with an unfavorable outcome, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun fled to submit.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the fifth month Song armies reached Hedong; Han fought them and was beaten, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun came over in flight.

literal: In the sixth month, Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and Han perished.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and the state of Han was extinguished.

literal: On jiazi day, Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun made co-director of the Secretariat and co-chancellor under the Gate.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun was made co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.

literal: The Song ruler came to invade.
idiomatic: The Song emperor marched to invade.

literal: On dingmao day, Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe struck them.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe moved to intercept them.

literal: They fought at Sha River and suffered defeat.
idiomatic: They engaged at Sha River and were defeated.

literal: On jisi day, the Song ruler besieged Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Song emperor laid siege to Nanjing.

literal: On dingchou day, an edict instructed Yelü Sha and Xidi, Taogu, and others on army affairs.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict addressed Yelü Sha, Xidi, Taogu, and the other commanders on conduct of the campaign.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guiwei day, Sha and the others fought Song troops at Gaoliang River and briefly gave ground;
idiomatic: On guiwei day in the seventh autumn month Sha and his forces fought Song at Gaoliang River and briefly fell back;

literal: Xiuge and Xiezhen struck from the flank and routed them completely.
idiomatic: Xiuge and Xiezhen then struck from the flank and routed the Song army.

literal: The Song ruler barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he secretly fled away in a donkey cart.
idiomatic: The Song emperor barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he slipped away secretly in a donkey cart.

literal: On jiashen day, the remaining Song troops were struck down; those killed were very numerous, and weapons, armor, tally-seals, grain, and goods captured were beyond counting.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the remaining Song forces were attacked; the slaughter was immense, and arms, armor, seals, provisions, and booty taken were beyond reckoning.

literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.

literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.
idiomatic: On renzi day in the eighth month Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.

literal: On yichou day, Yelü Sha and others presented captives.
idiomatic: On yichou day Yelü Sha and the others presented prisoners.

literal: On bingyin day, Sha and Mochi were blamed for the White Horse campaign yet released on account of driving off the Song ruler;
idiomatic: On bingyin day Sha and Mochi were censured for White Horse Ridge but pardoned for their success in driving off the Song emperor;

literal: Xidi, meeting the enemy, withdrew and was struck with the flat of a sword;
idiomatic: Xidi, who had retreated before the enemy, was beaten with the flat of a sword;

literal: Sahe, though he had fallen back, kept his ranks unbroken and was pardoned;
idiomatic: Sahe, though forced back, kept his formation intact and was forgiven;

literal: under Prince of Ji Delie those who fled first were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward they were caned.
idiomatic: under Prince of Ji Delie the first to flee were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward offenders were flogged.

literal: On renshen day, Sha, Mochi, and other officers were feasted and gifts were granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On renshen day Sha, Mochi, and the other commanders were banqueted and rewarded according to rank.

literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was made commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others each leading their troops south on campaign;
idiomatic: On jimao day in the ninth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was named commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, and tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others were each ordered south with their commands;

literal: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was still ordered to lead Shanxi troops advancing by separate routes.
idiomatic: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was also commanded to lead Shanxi forces forward by separate routes.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on yichou day, Han Kuangsi fought Song troops at Mancheng and was defeated.
idiomatic: On yichou day in the tenth winter month Han Kuangsi fought Song at Mancheng and suffered defeat.

literal: On xinwei day, Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song troops at Huoshan and defeated them.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song at Huoshan and routed them.

literal: On yihai day, an edict enumerated five offenses of Han Kuangsi and pardoned him.
idiomatic: On yihai day an edict listed five crimes of Han Kuangsi and then pardoned him.

literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Xiuge and meritorious officers were feasted and rewarded.
idiomatic: On wuyin day in the eleventh month Xiuge and other officers who had earned merit were banqueted and rewarded.

literal: On yiwei day, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi submitted a memorial remonstrating against hunting; it was praised and accepted.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi memorialized against the hunt, and the counsel was praised and heeded.

literal: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, an amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Qianheng.
idiomatic: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, the court proclaimed an amnesty and changed the era name to Qianheng.

literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely appointed Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and demoted to Prince of Qin.
idiomatic: On yimao day in the twelfth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely made Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and reduced in rank to Prince of Qin.

literal: On renxu day, Prince of Shu Daoyin was Nanjing regent and was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.
idiomatic: On renxu day Prince of Shu Daoyin, Nanjing regent, was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.

literal: That winter, the court encamped at Nanjing.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Nanjing.

literal: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the princes Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.
idiomatic: In the second year of Qianheng, on the bingzi new moon of the first spring month, the princes Longxu and Longqing were enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Prince of Heng respectively.

literal: On dinghai day, tithen Xiuge was made Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping commandery.
idiomatic: On dinghai day tithen Xiuge was appointed Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed Prince of Xiping commandery.

literal: In the second month, on wuchen day, he went to Qing River.
idiomatic: On wuchen day in the second month the Emperor went to Qing River.

literal: In the third month, on dinghai day, Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men presenting Tangut captives.
idiomatic: On dinghai day in the third month Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men with Tangut prisoners.

literal: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, a bustard flew and alighted on the imperial tent; it was taken and used to sacrifice to heaven.
idiomatic: On gengwu day in the intercalary month a bustard flew down onto the imperial tent, was captured, and offered in sacrifice to heaven.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on gengchen day, prayer was made for rain.
idiomatic: On gengchen day in the fourth summer month the court prayed for rain.

literal: On wuzi day, he escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.

literal: In the fifth month, lightning set fire to a pine at Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: In the fifth month lightning struck and burned a pine at Qian Mausoleum.

literal: In the sixth month, on jihai day, Xiyin again plotted rebellion and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.
idiomatic: On jihai day in the sixth month Xiyin plotted rebellion again and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day, Wangliu and others presented Tangut captives.
idiomatic: On wuwu day in the seventh autumn month Wangliu and the others presented Tangut prisoners.

literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu day, he traveled east.
idiomatic: On wuxu day in the eighth month the Emperor traveled east.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinwei day the new moon, shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.
idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the tenth winter month shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.

literal: On xinsi day, about to campaign south, he sacrificed to banners and drums.
idiomatic: On xinsi day, preparing to march south, the Emperor sacrificed to the campaign banners and drums.

literal: On guiwei day, he halted at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the court halted at Nanjing.

literal: On dinghai day, an enemy captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.
idiomatic: On dinghai day a captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.

literal: On gengyin day, he halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On jihai day, Waqiao Pass was besieged.
idiomatic: On jihai day the army besieged Waqiao Pass.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day the new moon, Song troops raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende fought them off.
idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the eleventh month Song forces raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende beat them back.

literal: On renyin day, Xiuge defeated Song troops east of Waqiao; the defending general Zhang Shi led troops out to fight, and Xiuge struck fiercely and routed them.
idiomatic: On renyin day Xiuge routed Song east of Waqiao; when the garrison commander Zhang Shi sallied forth, Xiuge attacked fiercely and put his force to flight.

literal: On wushen day, Song troops formed battle lines south of the water; Xiuge crossed the water, broke them, and pursued to Mozhou, killing and wounding very many.
idiomatic: On wushen day Song drew up south of the river; Xiuge waded across, shattered their line, and pursued to Mozhou, inflicting heavy casualties.

literal: On jiyou day, Song troops came again and were struck until nearly annihilated.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Song forces returned and were attacked until nearly wiped out.

literal: On bingchen day, the army withdrew.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the army withdrew from the campaign.

literal: On yichou day, he returned and halted at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On yichou day the Emperor returned and encamped at Nanjing.
